text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today is the Yasuda Kinen, and the racecourse has been buzzing with energy since the early morning.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I can't believe it's already this packed! I hope they haven't run out of Ogurin merch.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text: Let's divide and conquer! You go line up for merch. I'll get permission for our banner.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me everyone here is an Oguri fan!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the line for merchandise extending all the way to the entrance, the crowd is almost impossible to squeeze through. Oguri Cap's popularity is unbelievable.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And we're now in the belly of the beast!
I know, right? It almost feels like we're the away team playing at Oguri Stadium, huh?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Good morning, Bamboo.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Morning. Between us and Oguri, this is a decisive race for our class.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Still… we need to get really fired up if we don't want to get smothered by the intense mood.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It isn't like you to sound so dispirited. Are you feeling down? Is your heart not in the race?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Well, actually, I went and lost my kendo sword…

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I was on disciplinary committee patrol after classes and I set it against the wall so I could jot something down in my notebook.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: While I was writing, I noticed someone breaking the rules. She took off when I spoke up, so I ran after her.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: When I realized I'd forgotten my sword and went back for it, it was already gone.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I went to the lost and found, but no luck!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I know this isn't the time to be worrying about a bamboo sword, but still…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: It's all right to be upset. It's important to you.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: That said, I'm sure some kind soul found it and put it somewhere safe. That's what I would have done.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: You think so?! Heh… That's a weight off my shoulders!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: All right! Now I'm ready to race!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And that's a weight off my shoulders. Let's go!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Hey, Bamboo. You leave your sword behind the school?

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: I did! You found it?!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Okay, good. I had a feeling it was yours. I've been holding onto it.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Really?! I've been looking for it everywhere! Thank you so much!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Huh, I guess I should've brought it with me.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Don't worry about it! Just knowing you have it is a load off my chest. Now I'll be able to give it everything I've got on the track!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: I'm glad to hear that. Show me what you've got.

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Raaaaah! I'm so fired up! Is there anything better than good rivals who bring the best out of each other?!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: There's no bond as hot as the one between friendly foes!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text: Oguri! As thanks for finding my sword, I'm gonna run the best I've ever run!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Good. Glad to hear.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: The bond between friendly foes… In my case…

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I need to keep my end of our promise to do each other proud.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I'm running for the two of them as well! I will beat Oguri and Bamboo for all three of us!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan A
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaah! Oguriiiiin!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Fan B
text_block_list.text: I've been waiting for this day, Oguri! Good luck!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text: Hey, Yaeno Muteki! Lookin' good! Take everyone down today!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: There are some who have taken to me. However, that number is nothing compared to Oguri's fans.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: …But that changes today!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Now that my mastery of blaze fierce, water still gives me control of my burning obsession, I can do it!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will surpass Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: I will burn this run into the memories of everyone watching!
